profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced software developer working with start-up companies from leading the early stages - launching projects from idea to working applications - as well as companies with projects on a solid code base expanding on functionality.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: DocSend was acquired by Dropbox in March 2021.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Consistently working on multiple projects from planning to launch, and beyond. Responsibilities included requirement discussions directly with clients, planning and establishing tasks and their time frames, developing, testing, and proving support during and after launch.
* Implementing new features both in the back-end and front-end, using the tools the project requires such as Ruby on Rails, JavaScript libraries and frameworks, Capistrano, RSpec, and others.
* Project areas include: social networks, background checks, training, shopping and subscription services, marketplace in the transportation industry and GPS tracking.

positions.title: Software developer
positions.description:
DC based start-up offering a way to get better information to restaurants about their customers. 

* Maintaining the web application for loyalty customers, adding new features to the website and code and query optimization for restaurants all over the country.
* Data mining and implementing new queries to generate reports used by the venue managers to improve reach and customer retention.
* Refactoring legacy code and software practices to improve quality standards.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
DC based fantasy league and betting start-up . 
* Worked on the back-end adding payment system
* Improved user experience in multiple pages of the site.

positions.title: Independent contractor
positions.description:
Worked on in-house CMS and ERP project to manage the clients, suppliers, projects, activities, employees, among other.
* Talked directly with the client getting the project requirements, planning, and set time frames for each iteration.
* Designed the architecture, and completely implemented the project functionalities.
* Provided feedback and advised the client on improvements for the project.

positions.title: Research assistant
positions.description:
The objective of the project was to made a research to optimize the sending of Ip tv packages using evolutionary algorithms.

Responsibilities: 
I researched about evolutionary algorithms and developed a custom evolutionary algorithm in C and C++ based in NSGAII algorithm.
